title: ReliefWeb Post API schema - report resource

url.description: An immutable, unique identifier in URL format under your organization's domain (e.g., https://myorganization.org/report/12345). Used as the seed to derive the document's UUID v5 and link subsequent updates. Must never change after initial submission. It does not need to resolve to a live web page.

uuid.description: The document's UUID (version 5, RFC 4122). Compute it as uuid5('8e27a998-c362-5d1f-b152-d474e1d36af2', url), where url is the exact string in this document's 'url' property above. Submissions are rejected if the value does not match what the server computes. Example: uuid5('8e27a998-c362-5d1f-b152-d474e1d36af2', 'https://myorganization.org/report/12345') = 'c27c51bd-e6b6-5c09-91fd-ef122afdde8e'.

title.description: Document title. Use the original title of the article or file. If the title is from a series, add the date and other information as appropriate.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

source.description: Document source(s) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/sources.

country.description: Document country(ies) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/countries. The first country in the list is considered the primary country, meaning the most relevant to the content of the document. Otherwise, enter them alphabetically. Only tag the most relevant countries as over-tagging often results in reduced discoverability.

format.description: Document format as an array containing a single ID from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/content-formats. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.

language.description: Document language(s) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/languages. If an attachment is not in one of the official UN languages, mention that in the description of the attachment.

published.description: Original publication date-time (ISO 8601) of the document.

body.description:
Document content in markdown or html (supported tags:


    1. ). For a textual article, put the entire content. For attachments, use an executive summary, overview or key points of the core document. Use the file field for the attachment.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces and UNIX newlines (\n).

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces and new lines (except at the end of a line to support markdown linebreaks).

embargoed.description: Date-time (ISO 8601) until when the document is embargoed. It will be automatically published on that date. It must be a UTC/GMT date.

origin.description: Public URL where the document can actually be viewed, if one exists. Unlike 'url' above, this must be a real, accessible link rather than just a unique identifier.

file.description: List of PDF attachments with a valid public URL from which to download them. Maximum 20MB per file.

url.description: Valid public URL to a PDF file that can be downloaded during import (must end in .pdf without query parameters).

uuid.description: This file's UUID (version 5, RFC 4122). Compute it as uuid5(document_uuid, file_url), where document_uuid is this document's own 'uuid' property above and file_url is this file's 'url' property. Submissions are rejected if the value does not match what the server computes. Example: uuid5('c27c51bd-e6b6-5c09-91fd-ef122afdde8e', 'https://myorganization.org/report/12345/attachment.pdf') = '78d63e84-e2b4-5467-813d-1c2456f40d63'.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

checksum.description: Lowercase SHA-256 checksum of the file.

description.description: Optional brief description or title of the file.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

language.description: Optional ISO2 code of a supported UN official language (ar, en, es, fr, ru, zh) or ot (other). Add 'German Version', for example, to the description field above if the attachment is not in a supported UN official language.

image.description: Image to illustrate the document with a minimum width of 700px and a maximum size of 5MB.

url.description: Valid public URL to an image file that can be downloaded during import (must end in .jpg, .png or .webp without query parameters).

uuid.description: This image's UUID (version 5, RFC 4122). Compute it as uuid5(document_uuid, image_url), where document_uuid is this document's own 'uuid' property above and image_url is this image's 'url' property. Submissions are rejected if the value does not match what the server computes. Example: uuid5('c27c51bd-e6b6-5c09-91fd-ef122afdde8e', 'https://myorganization.org/report/12345/image.png') = '76d64603-5ab0-51a2-9444-758732250a64'.

checksum.description: Lowercase SHA-256 checksum of the image.

description.description: Alternative text describing the content of the image.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

copyright.description: Short copyright information for the image.

allOf.description: No control characters or separators except for spaces.

not.description: No leading, trailing or consecutive spaces.

disaster.description: Document disaster(s) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/disasters. Only select the most relevant disasters as over-tagging often results in reduced discoverability.

disaster_type.description: Document disaster type(s) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/disaster-types. Only select the most relevant disaster types as over-tagging often results in reduced discoverability.

theme.description: Document theme(s) as a list of IDs from https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/references/themes. Only select the most relevant themes as over-tagging often results in reduced discoverability. For definitions, see https://reliefweb.int/taxonomy-descriptions.

notify.description: List of email addresses to notify when the document is published.
